title: Navigating the ambiguity of impact investing: how impact venture capitalists access new markets, founders, and capital
core_idea: Investigate how impact venture capitalists handle and mobilize the contested definition of social and environmental impact in their everyday practices, applying Michel de Certeau's philosophy to analyze tactical maneuvers around market entry, fundraising, and founder relationships and to surface related ethical and normative questions.
tldr: Examines how impact venture capitalists navigate the contested meaning of 'impact' in practice, using de Certeau to analyze tactical approaches concerning markets, limited partner capital, and founder engagement and to highlight ensuing ethical questions.
